Training feature independence and redundancy

Training only: 310 company-events, 91 bankrupt and 219 non-bankrupt; 245 company groups. No validation/test matrices or IDs were opened.

Diagnostic report, not automatic selection. No predictors were removed and no matrix/preprocessing artifact was modified. Correlated groups may be retained for Elastic Net. Original matching/outcome-surveillance/vintage limitations remain unresolved by these diagnostics.

Diagnostic scope

Pearson/Spearman cover median-imputed training predictors. Raw observed-value correlations use pairwise complete numerical observations with minimum n=30; compare the two views in feature_redundancy.csv. Categorical/missingness features are discrete for mutual information. Zero correlation does not establish independence.

Selection/review policy

finding review_action
High Pearson/Spearman correlation Retain correlated groups for Elastic Net consideration; do not remove every pair above a threshold
Exact/affine duplicate values Review field definitions and future behavior before choosing an alias representative
Repeated missingness pattern Training equality may not persist when new observations become missing; do not silently collapse indicators
Training-constant dummy/indicator No current training variation; reserved missing/unseen behavior may activate later, so any omission must be explicit
Full-design VIF infinity The unpenalized multivariate design is not identifiable. Regularization/structured reduction is required; block VIF is supplementary
Univariate separation/fit warning Unpenalized MLE inference is withheld. Consider regularized modeling later rather than interpreting an extreme odds ratio
MI or univariate significance Training ranking only; do not use it as independent validation or tune decisions on test results

Variance inflation factors

Full-design VIF includes all nonconstant predictors and an intercept through centering. Null-space participation implies exact dependency and infinity. Finite values are reported only for individually identifiable features. Block VIFs use smaller, explicitly different designs; alias/reference omissions are diagnostic only.

Mutual information and univariate logistic regressions

GLMs have one predictor and an intercept, with company-group clustered standard errors. Numeric coefficients use one training SD; dummy/missing coefficients compare 0 to 1. Support separation, convergence problems, warnings, and nonfinite inference withhold MLE statistics. Rare binary levels are flagged. BH correction covers valid fits only. Training AUC is resubstitution performance, never a held-out result.
